note: A10.6: .avsc is routed explicitly (not via A10.8's .json sniff), and each named Avro type (record / enum / fixed) becomes a MESSAGE_TYPE with the A10.5 qname shape message:avro:<fullname>. Fullname is Avro's own: a nested named type inherits the enclosing NAMESPACE (com.shop.Address), it is not qualified by the outer record's name, because that is the name every Avro codegen and every other .avsc refers to it by. Nesting is structural: outer DEFINES nested, as A10.5 does for proto.
